test_title: PYST 40: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question has two statements followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

Some metres are litres.

No litre is a gram.

Conclusions

(I) Some grams are not metres

(II) All grams being metres is a possibility.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4495468c95695927df05b755e2a5413da3682a91a30822e1b134b8e1a65ed90d.png] 

**Conclusions**

(I) Some grams are not metres → False ( As, there is no direct relation between grams and metres)

(II) All grams being metres is a possibility → **True **(As, there is no direct relation between grams and metres but in possibility it can be true).

Thus, Only conclusion (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
